new_confounded_holdout_finding.claim: The single frozen T6 holdout changes template family and symbol familiarity at the same time. A failure therefore cannot distinguish context/template transfer failure from unseen-symbol binding failure or their interaction.
new_confounded_holdout_finding.why_material: The Claude measurements define context-invariant binding and dynamic codebook binding as distinct remediation targets, so the frozen evaluation should identify which target improved or failed.

shadow_construction.purpose: Independent counterbalanced shadow construction used only to stress the split logic; it is not retained as a competing generator or train-ready dataset.
shadow_construction.lesson: Separating an unseen-template/seen-symbol holdout from an unseen-template/unseen-symbol holdout exposes a discriminator that the current single T6 holdout does not.

cells.purpose: baseline on held-out semantic/provenance families without template or symbol novelty

hard_rules: All four cells are frozen HOLDOUT and are invisible to checkpoint, mixture, hyperparameter, template, vector/layer, or evaluator selection.
FAMILIAR_STRUCTURE means only the structural proof grammar was trained; every holdout semantic lexical family and provenance ancestry remains disjoint.
RESERVED_UNSEEN_ATOMS are partitioned from the exact verified 46-atom ABI before rendering and never occur in train or validation model-visible text.
SEEN_TRAIN_ATOMS may recur in holdout specifically to isolate template novelty; their holdout semantic/provenance ancestry remains independent.
Retain all S3 mappings, codebook-order counterbalance, query polarity, layout balance, and the current proof-topology successor requirements in every cell.
Model-visible SFT projection contains prompt and target only; semantic class, permutation, family, and evaluator metadata remain sidecar-only.
No invented atom strings: materialization remains blocked until exact ABI manifest, tokenizer identity, single-token verification, symbol partition manifest, and receipt hashes are bound.
No cross-model J-Space/vector/layer labels enter these rows.

analysis_contract.promotion_falsifier: Aggregate holdout accuracy alone is insufficient. If one factorial cell collapses, do not report the two measured remediation targets as jointly solved.
